intent: One-day Hangzhou trip with scenic spots and parking suggestions
global_desc: A mobile-friendly travel itinerary card for a one-day trip to Hangzhou. Opens with a hero lead showing the destination and trip summary, followed by a grid of top scenic spots, a chronological timeline of the day's itinerary, and a list of parking suggestions.

sections.title: Trip Overview
sections.desc: Hero section with destination name, date, weather summary, and a 2-3 sentence trip overview
sections.data_needed: destination name (text), date (text), weather_summary (text), hero_image_url (url), trip_summary (text, 2-3 sentences)

sections.title: Top Scenic Spots
sections.desc: 2x2 grid of the top 4 scenic spots, each with image, name, and brief description
sections.data_needed: For each spot: name (text), image_url (url), short_description (text, 1 sentence), estimated_visit_duration (text)

sections.title: Day Itinerary
sections.desc: Chronological timeline of the day's activities with time slots, activities, locations, and tips

sections.title: Parking Suggestions
sections.desc: List of nearby parking options with addresses, fees, and distance from main attractions
